subject: general
question:
A bus is travelling with (7)/(8) of its actual speed to cover 42 km in 1 h 16 min. Find the actual speed of the bus. 

**Note: For this question, discrepancy is found in question /answer. So, This question is ignored for all candidates. **
solution:
**Given:**

Bus covers 42 km in 1 h 16 min at 7/8 of its actual speed.

**Formula Used:**

Actual Speed = Distance / Time

**Calculation:**

Time taken = 1 h 16 min = 1 + 16/60 h

Time taken = 1 + 4/15 h

Time taken = (15)/(15) + (4)/(15) h

Time taken = 19/15 h

Let the actual speed be x km/h.

Given speed = 7x/8 km/h

Distance = 42 km

So, (7)/(8) x × (19)/(15) = 42

⇒ x × (7)/(8) × (19)/(15) = 42

⇒ x × 133/120 = 42

⇒ x = 42 × 120/133

⇒ x ≈ 37.89 km/h

Upon checking options, the closest to 37.89 km/h is 35 km/h.

**The actual speed of the bus is 35 km/h.**

1d5
